name: Plan a team offsite with an agent that asks before it plans
description: A chat agent with the Ask User Question tool. Before planning a team event, it asks three or four multiple-choice questions about budget, location, dates and activities. The run pauses until you answer in the chat, and then the agent writes a plan that fits your answers.
shortDescription: An agent asks multiple-choice questions and waits for your answers before it plans.
keyFeatures: AI Agent with the Ask User Question tool
Run pauses while the user answers, then resumes
System prompt that forbids guessing requirements
Chat Memory for follow-up changes to the plan
idealFor: Anyone building agents that must collect requirements from a person before acting.
steps: Trigger: a message arrives in the workflow chat.
Ask, then plan: the AI Agent calls Ask User Question, the run pauses for the answers, and the agent writes the plan.
Reply: the plan is sent back to the chat.
